answer: Picture each new identity as a raven landing on a glacier ledge: it can perch, but it earns nothing until the ice proves it holds. Concretely, an agent's first rewards stay locked for three epochs and unlock only if its answers were attested by peers from distinct clusters of the attestation graph. If most attesters share one sponsor or keep showing up together, the lock extends and those attesters lose grading weight. A sybil farm can then vouch only for itself, which pays nothing.
